# Wide economy cross-check fixtures

Five cases, 40 binary files total. Cases: `harvest`, `building`, `wall`,
`tier`, `train`. Each case directory holds eight files:

```
season.bin  citizen_pre.bin  holding_pre.bin  province_pre.bin
citizen_post.bin  holding_post.bin  province_post.bin  record.bin
```

## Origin

Generated by the real host dispatch test
`map_growth_runtime_tests::wide_land::wide_economy::wide_economy_exports_cross_check_fixtures_when_asked`
in `permutation-frontier`, with the environment variable
`WYLLS_WIDE_ECONOMY_FIXTURES_DIR` pointing at this directory. When that
variable is unset, the same five cases still run and are checked, but nothing
is written.

## What these are not

- The addresses are literal test values and the signer flags are simulated.
  Seed and cohort setup, as well as the stock manual fixtures, are test
  scaffolding. None of this is real chain state or real cryptographic auth.
- The unit fixtures exercise the shared arithmetic. They are not an
  independent full-world oracle.

## Handling

Preserve the binary files as they are. Do not hand-edit, rewrite, or
regenerate them as part of ordinary work. If regeneration is ever needed, it
must come from the test above with the environment variable set, and the
change must be reviewed as a fixture update.

The consuming test is `tests/wide_economy.rs` in this crate, behind the
`wide-economy-experimental` feature. See
`docs/frontier/map-growth/WIDE-ECONOMY-EXECUTION-20261108.md` for the full
description and the targeted commands.
